facts.value: Obtains Fighter from gobj once and passes gobj through five ordered early-return checks: ftCo_SpecialAir_CheckInput, ftCo_80095328 with NULL second argument, ftCo_800C3B10, ftCo_80099A58, and ftCo_AttackAir_CheckItemThrowInput. If all return false, reads input.lstick[0].y and common close_parasol_threshold; only an inclusive <= comparison evaluates ft_80087988. A true compound guard calls ftCo_Fall_Enter; any false compound guard instead calls ftCo_800CB870. No value is returned.

facts.value: Forwards gobj through inline ftCo_ItemParasol_Phys to ftCo_ItemParasolOpen_Phys. Shared physics multiplies fighter gravity and terminal velocity by common-data x590 and passes them to ftCommon_Fall. When ABS(input.lstick[0].x) >= x258, including equality, drift is x58C * (stick_x * air_drift_stick_mul) and target velocity is x58C * (stick_x * air_drift_max); otherwise both terms are zero. ftCommon_8007D140 receives those terms and aerial_friction. The source does not establish actual multiplier magnitudes or guarantee reduced descent for arbitrary data.
